answers.answer: Ready shows an error in place of its cards, "Couldn't load this column.", with a "Try again" button. The other four columns show their cards. The count line counts only the loaded columns and leaves out Ready's 7 cards, e.g. "Showing 18 cards".
The full board with all five columns loaded. 2 board loads were requested in all. Focus is on the board heading/region, because the Try again button is gone.
Title "SL-102 · <card title> — Slate". 2 card loads.
Address is still #/. The 250 ms debounce has not fired, so Backlog shows all of SL-101 to SL-110.
Address #/?q=login%20fix. History did not grow (the entry was replaced; same count as start). Backlog shows only SL-102 and Ready shows no cards ("No matching cards").
Enter applies the filter at once and moves focus to the first matching card, SL-125.

Address #/?q=search%20results&labels=perf,bug (unknown label 'nope' dropped, query trimmed and collapsed). History did not grow (replaced). Shown are only cards whose text contains "search results" and that carry perf or bug.
The second card of Review, at the same position (or the last card if Review is shorter).
Focus leaves the board (roving tabindex) and goes to the next focusable control after it.
The first Escape clears the filter text, so the address becomes #/. The second Escape leaves the field and returns focus to card SL-125.
0. The first Shift+X selects the whole column; the second deselects it.
In progress has SL-101, SL-102 and SL-103 at the end, after its existing cards. The notice reads "Moved 3 cards to In progress." with action Undo. The selection is cleared.

Notice: "Moved 2 of 3 cards to Review. SL-107 couldn't be moved." with action Retry. SL-107 stays selected. Backlog: SL-101, SL-102, SL-103, SL-104, SL-105, SL-107, SL-109, SL-110. Review: its existing cards, then SL-106, SL-108.
Only the Ready cards labelled bug stay selected. Filtering pruned the hidden cards from the selection, and clearing the filters does not restore them.
SL-119 is in Review. Notice: "Moved SL-119 to Review." with action Undo.
SL-116 stays in Ready. In progress has reached its WIP limit. Notice: "In progress is at its limit." with no action. 1 move request in all.
Ready: SL-111, SL-112, SL-101, SL-113, SL-114, SL-115, SL-116, SL-117. Notice: "Moved SL-101 to Ready." with action Undo.
SL-107 is back in Backlog at its original place, and focus is on SL-107. Notice: "Couldn't move SL-107 to Ready." with action Retry.
SL-107 is in Ready. Notice: "Moved SL-107 to Ready." with action Undo.
SL-108 stays in Ready. Notice: "Couldn't undo the move of SL-108." with action Retry.
Focus is on SL-109, the new last card of Backlog. No delete request is sent yet. Notice: "Deleted SL-110." with action Undo.
No request has been sent. Yes, the notice is still shown.
Yes, one delete request has been sent. No, the notice is gone.
SL-105 is back in Backlog at position 5, and focus is on SL-105. No delete request was sent.
1 request: the SL-103 delete was committed when the second delete replaced its notice. Notice: "Deleted SL-105." with action Undo.
SL-125 is restored to its original column and position. Notice: "Couldn't delete SL-125." with action Retry.
Yes. Error notices stay until the user dismisses them or acts on them.
SL-101 stays in Ready, because Control+Z in a text field is the field's own text undo. 1 move request. Yes, the notice "Moved SL-101 to Ready." (action Undo) is still shown.
Message: "Title must be 80 characters or fewer." Focus stays in the Title field. No save was sent.
Yes, the title is accepted. Focus returns to the "Edit title" button. A save was sent.
The original title is shown again, along with the message "Title can't be empty." No save was sent.
Only bug, ui and perf can be pressed (to remove them); all other labels are disabled. Note: "A card can have at most 3 labels."
The new comment shows the trimmed text "First note" by You, marked "Sending…". Yes, the field is cleared and can still be typed in.
Address is #/card/SL-114. Enter added a newline. Escape in a field with a draft does not close the card, so focus stays in the comment field. No comment was sent.
The loaded comments of SL-120, or "No comments yet." if it has none. The error and the Retry button are gone.
Address #/?labels=bug. Opening the card pushed an entry and Escape went back, so the history has the same number of entries as at the start. Focus is on card SL-114.
The card detail of SL-114 again. History is +1 entry compared with the start (the board entry was pushed, Back moved within it). 2 card loads.
A loading state for SL-999 ("Loading card…"). Title "Loading… — Slate". Yes, one card load was requested.
